instruction: A candid documentary wide shot from a low angle captures an indoor training studio with a red carpet and white walls. In the foreground on the left, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) is seen from behind, holding the woman's foot. In the background on the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) faces the camera, balancing on her left leg with her right leg extended. The man (R1) holds her right foot firmly. The scene is brightly illuminated by overhead lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor.
